All signs.voice_body: OPEN NOW and feel the gentle push of new purpose. The Sun’s trine to the True Node lights a path toward authentic growth, inviting you to align daily actions with deeper values. Symbolically, it signals a shift from routine to meaningful intent; in your work, let enthusiasm guide the next project, and in relationships, let honesty be the anchor. Today, write a brief note to yourself, outlining one goal that reflects your truest self.
